exchanges: so gabriel's family came to visit today and it was a lot, his mum, his dad, his stepdad, all at once in our tiny kitchen
That sounds like a full house. Did everyone get along?
surprisingly yes they're all really civil, his parents split when he was little so they've had time to get used to it i guess
That's good for Gabriel, it must make visits much easier.
yeah definitely, his dad is this big loud guy, he coaches rugby for a kids team back home and he spent half the visit talking about some under 12s final
Ha, a proud coach. Kids' finals can be surprisingly intense.
so intense he showed us videos lol
Full commitment. Did Gabriel look embarrassed?
mortified
Parents' job description, honestly.
and then his mum remarried a few years back and the new guy is really quiet and sweet, total opposite, he's mad into cricket, plays every weekend in summer for a village team
Two very different sporting households. Sounds like Gabriel grew up with plenty of matches on TV.
lol yes. anyway they brought loads of food so we're sorted for the week
The best kind of visit then.
yaw ate most of it already
Ha, there's always one.
he's got an excuse though, he's packing because he's moving out end of the month, he's got a flat with his girlfriend in Croydon
Big step, moving in together. You'll miss him in the house, I'd imagine.
so much, he's the one who fixes everything
Losing the house handyman is a real loss.
we'll need a new housemate too, mr abiodun the landlord wants us to find someone ourselves
That can actually be better, you get some say in who moves in.
true true, hana has a friend who might be interested
A friend of a friend is often a safe bet.
hana's working at the gp surgery as a receptionist at the moment and her friend works there too
So at least they'd have schedules in common.
yeah. oh and i finally got my bike fixed at dmitri's place, he's the guy with the workshop under the railway arches
Good, a working bike makes a big difference. Was it expensive?
not really, he's very fair. he's got a cat that sleeps on the tyres, it's called boris
A workshop cat is a great touch. Boris sounds like he knows who's in charge.
definitely boris runs the place
Ha, they always do.
ok i got something wrong, yaw's flat isn't in Croydon it's in Peckham, Croydon is where his girlfriend lives now. i'm hopeless with this stuff
Easy mix-up when two places are in the story. At least it's not too far from here.
it's like twenty minutes on the bus so he can still come for dinner
That's close enough to keep him around.
he better
Ha, maybe make it a condition of moving out.
the people at number 9 are having their extension built finally, it's so loud
Building work is the worst for noise. How long is it supposed to last?
months apparently, the builders start at 7
Ouch, that's an early alarm you didn't ask for.
earplugs are on the shopping list
Good call, get the good foam ones.
gabriel's dad sent a message saying thanks for having them
That's a kind gesture. Sounds like it went well overall.
yeah it really did
Glad it was a good day.
me too, i was nervous
Understandable with that many people, but it sounds like you hosted well.
oh and hana just told me she got a place on the nursing degree starting in september, she's been wanting this for ages, she's going to leave the surgery
That's fantastic news for her. A big change, but it sounds like the right one.
she's so happy she cried
That's lovely, it clearly means a lot to her.
we're getting her a cake tomorrow
Perfect way to celebrate.

questions.message: what's gabriel's dad's sport, his actual dad i mean
where's yaw going to be living after he leaves
gabriel's stepdad is the rugby one right
i love a reason to buy cake honestly
